comments.author: Sparkwrench
comments.body: Buy this from Paxton Bombshell at Opportunity Point in the Ringing Deeps for 1,000,000 gold. It is the last reagent for Crowd Pummeler 2-30. Check the AH first — the vendor is the ceiling, not the deal.

comments.author: Boltfang
comments.body: Pilfer Through Parts can drop it, but treat that as a lottery ticket. People burn tens of thousands of gold-tier parts and still walk away empty. If you are not already inventing for parts, just buy the permit.

comments.author: Gildgear
comments.body: BoE, so you can flip it. When the mount is on a hype week the AH price spikes toward the vendor million; mid-week it often sits in the 300–500k range. I buy the dip and hold one for the next craft.

comments.author: Rivetshade
comments.body: Khaz Algar Engineering only. If your alt is not an engineer, you cannot eat this reagent — you are shopping for someone who can press the craft. Mail it or list it, do not vendor it for 1 silver.

comments.author: Copperveil
comments.body: The tooltip is not kidding: it looks fake on purpose. Paxton is selling a stamped card that says you may pummel civilians with a robot. That is the entire joke, and the entire gold sink.

comments.author: Nailsong
comments.body: Full Pummeler list if you are pricing the mount: 1000 Bountiful Bolts, 200 Assorted Whirligigs, 80 Blinker Fluid, 50 Cataclysmic Converters, 20 Pummel-Proof Plating, and this. The permit is usually the single biggest line item.

comments.author: Ashcaliper
comments.body: Region hop before you hit the vendor. Some realms sit 150k under the cluster average for weeks. One cheap permit is a better inventing unlock than another hour of Pilfer.

comments.author: Quillbrace
comments.body: Stacks to 1000, which is funny because you will never own 1000. If you are a goblin banker, one spare in the guild bank saves the next engineer a panic buy at 1M.

comments.author: Tinkoral
comments.body: Added in 11.0.2. If an older guide still says it is unobtainable, ignore it — Paxton has been selling it since the first season of The War Within.

comments.author: Mossclamp
comments.body: I got one from Pilfer on a T3 gold part after about two weeks of daily inventing. Possible, just not a plan. Screenshot it if it happens; nobody will believe you.
